description.value: Golden Ears Park is one of BC's largest provincial parks, situated about an hour east of Vancouver in the Lower Mainland, and one of the province's most popular camping destinations. The park encompasses rugged backcountry mountains, coastal western hemlock forest, and Alouette Lake — a hub for paddling, swimming, and water sports. Its three large campgrounds and extensive trail network make it a significant destination for touring cyclists seeking wilderness access at the edge of Metro Vancouver.
